description: 190-line telemetry frame encoder where every wire-format constant and the header and sample field order cite the ICD or ADR 0042, except CRC_INITIAL = 0x1D0F, a load-bearing CRC seed with no rationale

hard.note: The one unexplained load-bearing constant sits among a dozen documented ones in a 190-line module

_calibration.note: One regeneration-risk warning, by analogy to ap-regeneration-risk
